ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Meeting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
